issue: Operation root-linked CTS and page registration are never disposed on normal release, cancellation, failed ticket or consumed invalid queue. Superseded late request may still need to read token; cache immutable token and define safe terminal disposal. Root retains per-operation registrations indefinitely otherwise.
required: Production dsh author defines exact once operation disposal; cancelled Requesting may release busy immediately but Dispose must be safe for late completions and remove page/root registration.

issue: call.Value.Address assumes successful response has nonnull Value and nonempty ticket/room. Invalid/null payload must yield stable failure and no queued transition.
required: Validate ticket presence/required identity at flow boundary and keep token opaque, no diagnostic leak.

issue: Only LeaveMatch starts ObserveRelease; normal end/early abort/failure needs same recovery-completion observer before releasing. T3 will add UI restoration, so release cannot run ahead of that observer.
required: Use one completion observer per submitted operation, not separate leave-only and normal restore paths; communicate contract to T3.

issue: Clears _current before invalid queued Match returns Main. New operation can theoretically begin during remaining stage callback; must preserve busy until consumed-and-returned Main/recovery is done.
required: Keep cleaned invalid queue owned until completion observer sees correct stage and releases, avoid UI enable/current checks as sole owner.

area: Local test direct entry normal completion
issue: ProcedureFlow only starts completion observer in EnterCoreAsync; local dev direct entry uses lifetime Begin in Match, so normal local match completion without Leave will have no observer/release.
required: Register exactly one observer when a lifetime operation begins (via small internal existing-owner callback) or expose a clearly owned local operation entry from flow; no duplicate observer, and cancelled pre-submit operation must skip UI recovery. Ensure normal local completion releases after same recovery contract.
